The supplied exact transition reaches HumanDriving, but the finite inspection facts state that it is unreachable from a top-level initial entry. The proposed alternative that structural endpoint and trigger presence suffice is defeated because the obligation concerns the reachable transition behavior and the dossier supplies an exact reachability failure.
